Name: MENU_VALUE_TABLE_SPEC
Description: Value-to-text conversion tables for menu displays. A value is compared with the rows of a table in order (see Compare Type), and the first matching row gives the text shown.

Fields.Name: Comparison Value
Fields.Description: Value compared with the displayed value (see Compare Type).

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text shown when this row matches. A negative value is a SystemMessage text ID.

Fields.Name: Compare Type
Fields.Description: How the displayed value is compared with Comparison Value to decide whether this row matches (see the enum).
